selection: Retain proposed 32/1MiB/10ms if count32 saturated median reaches 750 transactions/s and paced500 median reaches 475 transactions/s with correctness. Count8/128 and age0/5/25 are one-axis screening controls, not production variants. If the proposed setting misses either threshold, inspect evidence and declare a new frozen variant before acceptance.
component_reference: single=True disables grouping within the candidate implementation; this is a same-code ablation, not the SP01 predecessor. Fresh full-stack comparisons use the SP01 runtime.
observer_control: bounded reader on/off is a component control with independent stopped-file correctness; it does not measure the complete end-to-end observer cost.
